description: A three-panel composite screening figure for low-density FeMnAlC steels, mixing two composition–property contour maps with a candidate-composition scatter plot. (a) is a filled contour map of κ-phase volume fraction (%) over Al (wt.%) = 5.0–9.0 (x-axis) versus C (wt.%) = 0.4–1.1 (y-axis); its colour bar runs from 0.4500 (dark blue) to 13.15 (red) with ticks near 2.000, 3.625, 5.213, 6.800, 8.388, 9.975 and 11.56, and contour lines are labelled 1.000, 3.000, 5.000, 7.000, 9.000 and 11.00. The κ fraction rises towards high Al and high C (top-right, red). (c) uses the same Al–C axes to map density (g/cm³); the colour bar spans 6.812–7.234 g/cm³ (ticks near 6.865, 6.918, 6.970, 7.023, 7.076, 7.129, 7.181) with contours labelled 6.900, 6.950, 7.000, 7.050, 7.100, 7.150 and 7.200; density falls towards high Al/high C, so minimum density coincides with maximum κ fraction. (b) is a scatter plot of candidate compositions, Al = 7.4–9.0 wt.% versus C = 0.5–1.1 wt.%, with a legend for "the target of κ fraction", "the target of density", "target components" and "validation component"; the validation component is a pink star near Al ≈ 8.0, C ≈ 1.0 wt.%. A cyan curved arrow element states "Density ≤ 6.900 g/cm³". Together the panels screen compositions that simultaneously maximise κ fraction and minimise density.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a filled contour map of κ-phase fraction (%) over Al (wt.%) = 5.0–9.0 and C (wt.%) = 0.4–1.1, with a colour bar from 0.4500 to 13.15 % and contour lines labelled 1.000, 3.000, 5.000, 7.000, 9.000 and 11.00.
In (a) the κ-phase fraction increases towards the top-right corner of the map (high Al, high C), reaching the red 11.00-level contour.
Panel (c) maps density (g/cm³) over the same Al–C space; its colour bar spans 6.812–7.234 g/cm³ and contour lines are labelled 6.900, 6.950, 7.000, 7.050, 7.100, 7.150 and 7.200.
In (c) density is highest (red, near 7.200 g/cm³) at low Al and low C and lowest (blue, near 6.900 g/cm³) at high Al and high C, i.e. the density minimum overlaps the κ-fraction maximum of (a).
Panel (b) is a scatter plot of candidate compositions with Al on the x-axis (7.4–9.0 wt.%) and C on the y-axis (0.5–1.1 wt.%), and a four-entry legend.
The legend of (b) reads exactly: 'the target of κ fraction', 'the target of density', 'target components' and 'validation component'.
The validation component in (b) is marked by a pink star located near Al ≈ 8.0 wt.% and C ≈ 1.0 wt.%.
A cyan curved arrow element carries the text 'Density ≤ 6.900 g/cm³', stating the maximum density constraint applied in the screening step.
The caption labels (a) as the volume fraction of κ (Y4), (b) as the composition optimization process and (c) as the density of steels (Y5).

Screening first imposed κ fraction ≥ 10 % and density ≤ 7 g/cm³, and a refined set of 30 candidate compositions was then identified using a minimum κ volume fraction of 11 % and a maximum density of 6.9 g/cm³.
The composition Fe-30Mn-8Al-1C was selected for experimental validation of the calculated screening results.
(a) is described as a correlogram whose right-hand colour-bar legend encodes the κ fraction/density by colour intensity, with increasing κ fraction generally improving strength.

subfigures.description: Filled contour map of κ-phase volume fraction (%) versus Al (wt.%, 5.0–9.0) and C (wt.%, 0.4–1.1). Colour bar 0.4500–13.15 %; contour lines labelled 1.000, 3.000, 5.000, 7.000, 9.000, 11.00. κ fraction increases towards the top-right (high Al, high C).

Scatter plot of candidate compositions, Al (wt.%) 7.4–9.0 versus C (wt.%) 0.5–1.1, with overlaid legend: 'the target of κ fraction' (blue circles), 'the target of density' (green circles), 'target components' (teal/dark circles) and 'validation component' (pink star near Al ≈ 8.0, C ≈ 1.0 wt.%). Represents the composition-optimization step.

Filled contour map of density (g/cm³) over the same Al (wt.%) 5.0–9.0 and C (wt.%) 0.4–1.1 axes. Colour bar 6.812–7.234 g/cm³; contours labelled 6.900, 6.950, 7.000, 7.050, 7.100, 7.150, 7.200. Density is highest (red ~7.200) at low Al/low C and lowest (blue ~6.900) at high Al/high C.
A cyan curved arrow carrying the single text label 'Density ≤ 6.900 g/cm³', an annotation of the density constraint used in the screening protocol.
